lines.zh: 我一脚踩进你的影子里
lines.en: I set one foot inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 袍子底下什么都没有，可它在走
lines.en: Nothing under the robe, yet it walks.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我已经换了位置
lines.en: When you look back, I've already moved.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，你走得更慢
lines.en: I don't walk fast; you walk slower.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在你心跳的空档
lines.en: Every step lands between your heartbeats.
I don't come through doors.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头那盏灯，我经过就灭了
lines.en: The lamp at the corridor's end goes out as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体长很多
lines.en: My shadow is much longer than my body.
That sound you heard wasn't me.

lines.zh: 我在你身后三步，一直三步
lines.en: I'm three steps behind you, always three.

lines.zh: 地面上的草被我踩过就歪了
lines.en: Grass bends where I step.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，你会数错
lines.en: Don't count my steps; you'll miscount.
The path I walk circles you.

lines.zh: 这块地方刚才还是空的
lines.en: This spot was empty a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手里是那个图腾
lines.en: I raise a hand; the totem is in it.

lines.zh: 你越早用掉它，我越早来
lines.en: The sooner you use it, the sooner I come.

lines.zh: 我站着，手里握着你的图腾
lines.en: I stand holding your totem.
I'm counting how many you've used.

lines.zh: 你身上那个东西，我认得
lines.en: I know the thing you carry.
The robe is still, yet the wind moves.
I tilt my head slightly.
This room is colder than it was.
I can see the calluses on your hands.

lines.zh: 每次你活下来，我就多一个
lines.en: Each time you survive, I gain one.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，时间就慢下来
lines.en: Standing here, I slow the time.

lines.zh: 那个图腾本来是救你的
lines.en: That totem was meant to save you.

lines.zh: 我手里的，是你还没用掉的那个
lines.en: What I hold is the one you haven't used.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子不是我一个
lines.en: There's more than one shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 你的名字我知道，但不必说
lines.en: I know your name, but needn't say it.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，这就够了
lines.en: My doing nothing is enough.
The hearth fire leans toward me.
You finally looked at me.
You know what's in my hand.
I don't kill you; I only collect.

lines.zh: 你活下来的次数，我记着
lines.en: I keep count of how often you survived.
Your shadow is trembling.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，眨一下我就不在原处
lines.en: Don't blink; blink and I'm elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我把图腾举起来给你看
lines.en: I raise the totem so you can see it.
This isn't a trade.

lines.zh: 你带着它，就等于带着我
lines.en: Carry it, and you carry me.
The longer you don't use it, the closer I am.

lines.zh: 图腾在你手里，你的呼吸我数着。
lines.en: The totem is in your hand; I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 我不说话，是因为没有话
lines.en: I don't speak because there's nothing to say.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，早晚是我的
lines.en: What you hold will be mine in time.
How many do you have left tonight?
Don't beg; I don't listen.

lines.zh: 这一下落在袍子上，没有反应
lines.en: The blow landed on my robe and nothing happened.
I stepped back only to yield.
There's no blood to spill.
I tilted my head.

lines.zh: 这个伤，不会留在我身上
lines.en: This wound won't stay on me.

lines.zh: 你听见自己打中的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear yourself land a hit?

lines.zh: 袍子破了一角，很快合上
lines.en: A corner of my robe tore and closed again.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，又看了看手
lines.en: I looked at you, then at my hand.
You want to try; go ahead.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我看的是你的手
lines.en: You raise that; I'm looking at your hand.
I'm not hungry; I only wait.
Offer it, and I still won't take it.
That won't buy a life.
You're holding something worth more.
Totems; totems are what I want.
Put it down and I won't touch it.
Don't hide it.
I've counted the ones you used.

lines.zh: 你把命数放在地上，我看见了
lines.en: You set your count on the ground; I see it.

lines.zh: 你手里剩几个，我算得清
lines.en: How many you have left, I can count.
Don't offer that to make me leave.

lines.zh: 我要的是你用掉的那个
lines.en: I want the one you spent.

lines.zh: 你把图腾扔远，也追不回来
lines.en: Throw the totem far; it won't come back.

lines.zh: 再拿一个出来，我就再看一次
lines.en: Bring out another and I'll watch again.
You stumbled into my robe.
Touch me and your hand stays cold for a long while.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，你也没过去
lines.en: I stepped aside, and you still didn't pass.

lines.zh: 我身上没有可以撞的东西
lines.en: There's nothing on me to collide with.

lines.zh: 你退回去的时候，位置变了
lines.en: When you stepped back, your position changed.
Don't walk that close to me.

lines.zh: 袍角落在你脚边，你踩上来了。
lines.en: My robe hem fell at your feet, and you stepped on it.
Did you hear that?
My hem brushed your leg.
Come again and I won't yield.
I'm not that sort of thing.

lines.zh: 我收的，都是别人活下来的次数
lines.en: What I collect is the times others survived.
I don't understand that question.
There is no second me.

lines.zh: 这世上只有我在这里等
lines.en: Only I wait here in this world.
What's in my hand is all of it.
You'll regret asking.
There's nothing under the robe.
Quiet.
This is what I want.
I don't bend; it comes on its own.
That one on the ground, you haven't picked it up.
It's in my hand now.

lines.zh: 我捡起的是别人的命数
lines.en: What I pick up is someone's count.
This isn't yours.

lines.zh: 地上散的东西，我一件件收
lines.en: I gather what's scattered, one by one.
You dropped it; I know.
My taking it makes it count.
Everything here comes to me.
You survived again.
That counts as one.
I felt that one.

lines.zh: 图腾亮起来的时候，我就到
lines.en: When the totem lights, I arrive.
One of your lives is gone.
Now you're very close to me.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，看清楚的那种
lines.en: I see you, in the way that counts.
No need to run.
When the count's up, I come.
A little more.
You used another.

lines.zh: 我手里的这个，和你那个是一对
lines.en: The one in my hand matches yours.
Your breathing is counting for you.
I'm behind you.
You turn, and I'm ahead.
All the lamps are out.
Soon; don't hurry.

lines.zh: 你手上那个的温度，我感觉得到
lines.en: I can feel the warmth of what you hold.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过去，你只觉冷
lines.en: My hand passes through; you only feel cold.

lines.zh: 你倒下了，图腾自己亮了
lines.en: You fell, and the totem lit by itself.
I watched it shatter.
This time, I count it.
You're not dead; you only spent one.
I stand before you.
The light around you scattered.
Now you understand.
The totem broke, and so I came.

lines.zh: 那道光里，先出现的是我的手
lines.en: In that light, my hand appears first.

lines.zh: 手里的图腾，是刚才那个
lines.en: The totem in my hand is the one from before.

lines.zh: 你活下来了，这不符合规矩
lines.en: You survived; that breaks the rule.

lines.zh: 你身上还留着复活的味道
lines.en: You still smell of resurrection.

lines.zh: 我从你背后三步的地方开始
lines.en: I begin three steps behind you.
You needn't look; I'm here.
The room's temperature drops.

lines.zh: 我手里这个东西，本来是你的
lines.en: What I hold was yours.

lines.zh: 你数过自己死过几次吗
lines.en: Have you counted how often you died?

lines.zh: 这一回，我等你用完下一个
lines.en: This time, I wait for you to spend the next.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，没有声音
lines.en: There's no sound when I appear.

lines.zh: 火烧不着我，倒是照见了我
lines.en: Fire won't burn me; it only shows me.

lines.zh: 我没有落下去，是地面下去
lines.en: I didn't fall; the ground dropped.
Water passes through me.
Through the blast, I didn't move a step.
The arrow went through and stuck behind me.
The spell dissipated before me.
I don't eat; I only count.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了整间屋，我还在
lines.en: Lightning lit the whole room, and I'm still here.
The void and I know each other well.
